settings.checkinEnableDesc: Marking an article as Finished in the library writes a reading event to Lv Checkin (write capability, local only). Requires Lv Checkin installed & enabled

settings.aiChannelDesc: SiYuan built-in = the model bound to "AI Editor" in Settings→AI; Glean-specific = a separate OpenAI-compatible API (great for free/cheap models; key encrypted in SiYuan secrets)
settings.customSecretDesc: Create a secret with your API key in SiYuan Settings→Secrets & variables, then enter its name here (kernel-encrypted, never stored in plugin files)
workbench.title: Glean Workbench
onboarding.title: Welcome to Lv Glean
onboarding.welcomeTitle: Three steps to your reading library
onboarding.welcomeBody: Pick up dusty clippings in SiYuan: status triage, AI summaries & tags, daily resurfacing. All data lives on your documents — nothing lost on uninstall.
onboarding.anchorHint: Pick the notebooks that hold your clipped articles (multiple allowed). Everything else can stay at its default and be changed anytime.
onboarding.aiLater: Want AI summaries and translation? Enable them later in Settings → AI enrichment (manual-only by default, nothing runs automatically).
onboarding.importLink: Have Pocket / Omnivore archives? Bring them in with the importer
onboarding.previewNote: Ordinary notes never enter the library: only articles with source evidence become candidates, and attributes are written only after per-article confirmation.
onboarding.scanFailed: Scan failed (notebook may be unreadable); go back or skip
onboarding.cap1: Capture clippings with word count & reading time
onboarding.cap2: Daily resurfacing picks up dusty items
onboarding.cap3: AI summaries & tags (via SiYuan built-in AI)
onboarding.doneHint: All set. Adjust anytime in Settings → Lv Glean. Workbench: top-bar wheat icon. Quick view: bottom-right Dock.
library.filterAiTagHint: AI tags are model-generated and separate from your own tag facets
